decisions.reason: As a recent extension of the firm’s established range with visible public commitment and no reported failure in a growing market, management is likely to continue backing it rather than reverse course quickly.
Because it builds directly on the established construction-equipment business and has already been publicly introduced, the firm is likely to stay committed and give it more time.

Although this mine rescue vehicle is more distant from the core offer and therefore somewhat more vulnerable, its dedicated launch and the firm’s engineering-driven, innovation-oriented profile still make continued commitment more likely than withdrawal after only one year.
This product fits the firm’s existing problem-solving machinery portfolio and service capabilities, so with fresh launch investment and public exposure management is likely to retain it.
